en: Color-printed postcard reproducing a historical painting or fresco inside a pointed Gothic arch. The scene shows a crowded religious or ceremonial gathering in rich Renaissance-style clothing: robed clergymen and laymen surround a central figure lying on a raised bier or altar, possibly being blessed or mourned. Behind them hang large draped banners in red and blue with gold finials and garlands. At the bottom is an ornate pointed doorway with ironwork, framed by patterned wall tiles and elaborate decorative borders. There is no visible printed caption or legible text on the image side.
